title: Screenprint
look: Flat posterised colours with an accent plate printed off register.

doc.essence: A gig-poster screenprint: a few posterised flat inks and an accent plate that slipped.
doc.notIt: Not riso (flat, not halftone), not flat (posterised, offset plate, grain).
doc.shapes: No outline; an accent-coloured offset copy of each silhouette.
pitfalls: Posterising can push two roles to the same colour.
